description: This Java class, TaxConfigurationController, is a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing tax configuration settings in an admin web interface. It provides methods to display and save tax configuration data, interacts with a TaxService, and manages menu display states.

classes.name: TaxConfigurationController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling tax configuration management in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display current tax configuration for the store, defaulting to a new configuration if none exists.

methods.name: saveTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update the tax configuration for the store.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Prepares and sets menu-related attributes for the view, highlighting the active menu items.
